input.title: iOS #50: updating over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the update-path rows of the QA Regression Runbook on the ZM store candidates (ZOM-570).

**Device / OS:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 store version from the App Store → updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50)

**What happens:** after the update the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. The account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins before the update. Relaunching doesn't bring the progress back.

**Repro:**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store.
2. Play past level 200.
3. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it.
4. Launch.

**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks survive the update (runbook: Save / progression, Update from N-1).

**Other update rows on the same run:** iOS N-2 → #50 pass; Android N-1 → #135 pass; Android N-2 → #135 pass.

Evidence: Brian's "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" doc (Sep 30). A failure in an UPDATE column blocks the release per the runbook, and lost progress / coins is a blocker under the ZM submission rules.

text:
QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO** as of today. There are 14 blockers, listed by key on ZOM-570. Full register is in the "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50" tab of my release gate sheet.

Heads up on the "matrix green" above: that's the fresh-install columns only. Brian's update-path run has **iOS #50 installed over N-1 resetting the save to level 1** (level 212 / 18,400 coins → level 1 / 500). An update-column failure blocks the release per the runbook. Nobody had filed it, so it's now ZOM-581.

Blockers:
• ZOM-581: iOS N-1 → #50 update wipes progress
• ZOM-435: trophy path stuck after a fast double-tap on claim. Leonard hit it on #135, and the fix is in the build
• ZOM-569: Season Pass double-open leaves a dead screen. The fix (a61cb2b) landed at 21:36, after #50/#135 started, so it's not in either candidate
• ZOM-567: Zombie Lane chests still don't land on prod. The #36 code is live, but the chest-row data load hasn't been run on prod
• ZOM-573: Collect&Win crashes when you claim the 5th chest (#135)
• ZOM-576: Season Pass tier 12 premium claim drops the boosters (#50)
• ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
• ZOM-546: endless refill drains the board until the run can't go on
• ZOM-554: quitting mid-tornado leaves the next level unplayable until a force-quit
• ZOM-483: new-install infinite-lives time gets cut on relaunch
• ZOM-560: abandoned pack doesn't deliver the win streak freezer
• ZOM-449: low-end Android freezes on a cold start into level 3
• ZOM-559: Samsung victory screen freezes after homing out (last seen on #133, not re-checked on these candidates yet)
• DES-313: level 214 can't be completed

Fixed on these candidates: ZOM-564, 517, 429; ZOM-563 is live on prod. 22 known issues are logged in the tab and don't block. Happy to re-gate a new cut before Friday's go/no-go.
